en: The postcard displays a black-and-white image of an elegant European street scene. On the right side is a large, ornate school building labeled as 'Palazzo delle scuole.' On the left, there is a church with a distinctive round window and a bell tower with an onion-shaped dome. Several people are seen walking or standing on the otherwise empty street. The postcard's upper border includes the text indicating the street name and buildings shown.
